title: 第十一章 超青藏高原63第十一章 超青藏高原62
lines: 五十八、羊狼熊人离开迷失之地后，三位勇者与胡伟沿荒原边缘走了约两日。
天白电的能量已彻底消散，莫星白瑶与锋珞的传送阵尚未再次亮起，短暂的战斗间隙里，神迹大陆的山川在暮色中显得格外宁静。
前方是一片低矮的丘陵，丘陵间散落着几块开垦整齐的农田，田垄间种植着各类作物，长势喜人。
“哞，前面有村庄。”胡伟的大熊猫耳朵在微风中轻轻转动。穿过一片果林，眼前豁然开朗。
那是一座风格简朴的村庄，建筑以木材与石料搭建，村口立着一块木牌，牌上刻着
“千寿”二字。村中往来的身影与人类别无二致——没有兽耳，没有兽尾，没有头人族，没有超兽族。
村民们在田垄间耕作，在井边打水，在屋檐下编织竹篓，看上去就是一座普普通通的人类村庄。
但全息界面在唐琼凯视觉中自动弹出检测结果——这些村民的基因结构极为特殊，绵羊、狼、熊三种动物的基因片段与人类基因完美嵌合，在每一个细胞中稳定共存。
基因层面与人类完全一致，但基因来源并非自然演化——而是实验室中的基因重组。
“不是纯人类。”唐琼凯推了推眼镜，
“三种动物基因——绵羊、狼、熊。黑暗伪人的基因工程造物。”四人刚走近村口，一个少年便迎了上来。
他穿着简洁的布衣，面容清秀温和，黑色的短发垂在额前，看上去与人类少年毫无区别。
“远道而来的客人，我是千禾。”他的声音温和有礼，
“长老让我在此等候——他说今天会有引导者和勇者经过本村。我们这里很久没有外来者了。”黄雪婧看着千禾那张与人类完全相同的面孔，问道：“你们的祖先是从哪里来的？”千禾正要回答，胡伟先开口了。
“哞。他们不是自然演化的种族。他们的祖先来自外太空某颗星球——黑暗伪人在那颗星球上建立了基因工程实验室。黑暗伪人取绵羊、狼、熊三种动物的基因，以人类为模板进行基因重组，创造出了与人类完全一致的生命。那不是女娲抟土造人的神话——是科技版的造人实验。泥土是培养基因舱，藤是输入营养液的管道，水是营养液。实验的目的不是创造生命，而是研究如何附身人类。”
“附身人类？”黄雪婧微微皱眉。

“科技世界的人类已经发现了基因。黑暗伪人若要潜伏在科技世界中，必须使附身对象的基因与人类完全一致，才能通过基因检测而不被识破。发达科技世界的人类已经可以星际旅游，基因检测技术普及，身份识别系统完善。黑暗伪人如果只是简单地替换外貌和记忆，在基因检测面前会立刻暴露——但黑暗伪人对基因并不了解。他们能替换外貌、记忆、声音，却无法复制基因的本质。所以他们在实验星球上搭建实验室，试图通过动物基因的重组来研究人类基因的奥秘，为附身技术寻找基因层面的突破口。”千禾接口道，他的声音依旧温和，但语气中多了一丝复杂的情绪：“实验成功了，也失败了。我们的祖先确实是完美的造物——基因稳定，寿命千年，与人类完全一致。但黑暗伪人根本无法附身他们。三种动物基因重组后形成了全新的基因结构，这种结构黑暗伪人完全不认识。他们找不到可以附身的基因锚点。实验暴露了黑暗伪人最大的弱点——他们对基因一无所知。”
“对黑暗伪人来说，这是最失败的实验品。”唐琼凯说，全息界面在他视觉中列出了基因分析数据，
“创造出了自己无法利用的生命。对光明伪人来说，这却是最成功的造物——无法被黑暗伪人附身的生命，本身就是对光明势力最有利的结果。光明伪人从不研究如何附身人类，他们只承接已死之人的肉身，不需要基因检测，不需要潜伏。黑暗伪人绞尽脑汁也做不到的事，光明伪人根本不需要做。”千禾点了点头，引着四人穿过村中街道。
村中的房屋错落有致，村民们在各自的门前忙碌着。一个老人坐在门廊下编织竹篓，手指翻飞间竹条被编成细密的纹路。
他的面容慈祥温和，看上去与任何一个安享晚年的老人没有区别。一个年轻的母亲蹲在井边洗衣，年幼的孩子在旁边追逐嬉闹，笑声在巷子里回荡。
田垄间，几个村民正弯腰插秧，动作熟练而从容。
“我们每个人都有多个独立的人格。”千禾边走边说，

“因为基因来源是三种动物，不同的人格在不同情境下轮流主导身体。这不是病态——对我们来说是天生的、稳定的常态。就像人类可以有多种情绪一样，我们只是将这三种情绪化为三种独立的人格而已。三个人格互不冲突，各自在不同的生活场景中出现。一个温和，一个果断，一个沉稳——都是同一个人，只是不同的人格侧面。”黄雪婧看着村中那些与人类毫无二致的面孔，忽然想起在天极四柱的虚拟世界里，大象青牛精神体让她经历的那些考试——尊老爱幼、守护弱小，这些不是靠题目能考出来的，只有本能无法伪装。
而眼前这些被黑暗伪人创造出来的生命，他们的本能不是黑暗伪人赋予的，是他们自己在千年寿命中一点一滴积累下来的。
黑暗伪人想用他们来研究附身，但他们从诞生之初便对附身免疫。不是因为他们有抵抗能力，而是因为黑暗伪人的附身技术根本够不到基因层面。
“你们是怎么来到神迹大陆的？”杨欣颖问。
“干预者派了机器人，将我们的祖先从实验星球接到了这里。”千禾说，
“白理雷音余韵在寻找神迹大陆与白金正蓝星球的途中，发现了那颗实验星球和我们的祖先。她没有亲自下去，而是派了机器人潜入，将羊狼熊人接出，投放到了神迹大陆。之后我们的祖先便在神迹大陆上繁衍生息，建立了这座村庄。我们是黑暗伪人基因工程的产物，但干预者给了我们独立于创造者之外的道路——不再是实验品，而是自由生活的种族。我们千年寿命中的每一分每一秒，都与黑暗伪人再无任何关系。”四人在千寿村停留了一日。
长老在议事堂中接待了他们，那是一位面容古朴、眼神深邃的老人，千年寿命在他的面容上留下了温和而非沧桑的痕迹。
他取出一块保存完好的晶体芯片放在案上——那是黑暗伪人实验室的记录芯片，记录了当年基因工程实验的全部过程。
培养基因舱的设计图、营养液的配比公式、三种动物基因的拼接序列，全部存储在芯片之中。
芯片是全息投影格式，唐琼凯用全息界面读取了其中的数据，将科技版
“抟土造人”的全部真相记录在体内芯片的存储区中。正在此时，一道银白色的光芒从虚空中落在唐琼凯手中——是白理雷音余韵的传讯。
唐琼凯展开传讯，全息界面在他视觉中自动打开，两组完整的资料数据包被传输至他体内的全息电脑芯片中。
“这是异能世界的部分陀螺资料，以及异能世界六名主角的详细档案。”白理雷音余韵的声音在他耳边响起，
“之前在观影异能世界时，这部分资料没有来得及展示。现在补全给你。魔法世界与科技世界的六人年龄均为十二岁至十三岁，而异能世界的六人年龄不同——他们更年幼。”唐琼凯将资料逐条调出，全息影像在他眼前铺展开来。
首先是陀螺资料。极焰风暴，配对引擎为天焰，单发右旋单核聚能引擎，攻击类型为主力攻击型，陀尖类型为平面圆形聚能尖，必杀技为风暴之眼、极焰冲击、极焰爆能。
炽羽凤凰，配对引擎为灵羽，左旋双核聚能引擎，攻击类型为防御反击型，陀尖类型为圆点形聚能尖，绝招为火羽封锁。
御空勇士，配对引擎为蓝印，单发左旋单核聚能引擎，攻击类型为近身敏捷型，陀尖类型为十字形聚能尖，必杀技为御空回转、御空寒风。

58. After the Sheep, Wolf and Bear Man left the Lost Land, the three brave men and Hu Wei walked along the edge of the wilderness for about two days.
The energy of Tianbai Electric has completely dissipated, and the teleportation arrays of Mo Xingbai Yao and Feng Luo have not yet lit up again. During the short battle gap, the mountains and rivers of Miracle Continent looked particularly peaceful in the twilight.
Ahead is a stretch of low hills. There are several neatly cultivated farmland scattered among the hills. Various crops are planted in the ridges and the growth is gratifying.
"Moo, there's a village ahead." Hu Wei's giant panda ears turned gently in the breeze. Passing through a fruit forest, my eyes suddenly opened up.
It was a simple village with buildings made of wood and stone. There was a wooden sign at the entrance of the village with the following words engraved on it:
The word "Qianshou". The figures coming and going in the village are the same as human beings - no animal ears, no animal tails, no head-humans, no super-orcs.
The villagers are farming in the fields, fetching water from the well, and weaving bamboo baskets under the eaves. It looks like an ordinary human village.
However, the holographic interface automatically popped up the detection results in Tang Qiongkai's vision - the genetic structure of these villagers is extremely special. The gene fragments of three animals, sheep, wolves, and bears, are perfectly chiseled with human genes and stably coexist in every cell.
The genetic level is exactly the same as that of humans, but the source of the genes is not natural evolution - but genetic recombination in the laboratory.
"Not purely human." Tang Qiongkai pushed up his glasses.
"Three animal genes - sheep, wolf, bear. Genetically engineered creations of dark pseudo-human beings." As soon as the four of them approached the entrance of the village, a young man came up to them.
He was wearing simple civilian clothes, with a delicate and gentle face, and short black hair hanging in front of his forehead. He looked no different from a human boy.
"Guest from afar, I am Qianhe." His voice was gentle and polite.
"The elder asked me to wait here - he said that there will be guides and brave men passing through the village today. We haven't had outsiders here for a long time." Huang Xuejing looked at Qianhe's face that was exactly the same as a human and asked: "Where did your ancestors come from?" Qianhe was about to answer when Hu Wei spoke first.
"Moo. They are not a naturally evolved race. Their ancestors came from a certain planet in outer space - the dark pseudoman established a genetic engineering laboratory on that planet. The dark pseudoman took the genes of sheep, wolves, and bears, and used human beings as a template for genetic recombination to create A life that is exactly the same as a human being was created. It was not a myth about Nuwa squeezing soil into a human being, but a scientific version of a human-creation experiment. The soil was a genetic chamber, the vine was a channel for nutrient solution, and the purpose of the experiment was not to create life, but to study how to possess humans.”
"Possessing a human being?" Huang Xuejing frowned slightly.
"Human beings in the technological world have discovered genes. If dark pseudo-people want to lurk in the technological world, they must make the possessed object's genes exactly the same as humans, so that they can pass genetic testing without being discovered. Human beings in the developed technological world can already travel to the stars, genetic testing technology is popularized, and the identity recognition system is complete Good. If the dark pseudo-humans simply replace their appearance and memory, they will be immediately exposed in front of genetic testing - but the dark pseudo-humans do not understand genes, but they cannot copy the essence of genes, so they set up a laboratory on the experimental planet and tried to use animal genes. "Recombination to study the mysteries of human genes and find a breakthrough at the genetic level for possession technology," Qian He said, his voice still gentle, but with a hint of complex emotions in his tone: "The experiment succeeded, but it also failed. Our ancestors were indeed perfect creatures - their genes were stable and they lived for thousands of years. They are completely the same as humans. But the dark pseudoman cannot possess them at all. The three animal genes have been recombined to form a new genetic structure, which the dark pseudoman cannot find at all. The experiment exposed the dark pseudoman's biggest weakness - they know nothing about genes."
"For the Dark Pseudoman, this is the most failed experiment." Tang Qiongkai said, the holographic interface listed the genetic analysis data in his vision.
"Creating a life that you can't use. For the light pseudo-people, this is the most successful creation - a life that cannot be possessed by the dark pseudo-people is itself the most beneficial result for the light forces. The light pseudo-people have never studied how to possess humans. They only take over the bodies of dead people. They do not need genetic testing or lurking. The light pseudo-people do not need to do what the dark pseudo-people rack their brains and cannot do." Qianhe nodded and led the four people through the streets of the village.
The houses in the village are scattered in a scattered manner, and the villagers are busy in front of their respective doors. An old man was sitting on the porch weaving bamboo baskets, and the bamboo strips were being woven into fine patterns as his fingers flew.
His face was kind and gentle, and he looked no different from any old man enjoying his old age. A young mother squatted by the well doing laundry, while young children chased and played nearby, and their laughter echoed in the alley.
In the ridges of the fields, several villagers were bending over to plant rice, their movements skillful and calm.
"Each of us has multiple independent personalities." Qian He said as he walked.
"Because the genes come from three animals, different personalities take turns to dominate the body in different situations. This is not a pathology - it is an innate and stable normality for us. Just like humans can have multiple emotions, we just turn these three emotions into three independent personalities. The three personalities do not conflict with each other, and each appears in different life scenes. A Wen One is decisive, the other is calm - they are all the same person, just with different personality aspects." Huang Xuejing looked at the faces in the village that were no different from human beings, and suddenly remembered the tests that the Elephant and Green Ox Spiritual Body had made her undergo in the virtual world of the Four Pillars of Heaven - respecting the elderly, caring for the young, and protecting the weak. These cannot be tested by questions, only instinct cannot be disguised.
As for the beings created by the Dark Pseudoman in front of them, their instincts were not given by the Dark Pseudoman, but were accumulated bit by bit by themselves during their thousand-year lifespan.
The Dark Pseudoman wanted to use them to study possession, but they were immune to possession from birth. Not because they have the ability to resist, but because the possession technology of the dark pseudoman cannot reach the genetic level at all.
"How did you come to Miracle Continent?" Yang Xinying asked.
"The interventionists sent robots to bring our ancestors here from the experimental planet." Qianhe said,
"Bai Lileiyin Yuyun discovered the experimental planet and our ancestors on her way to search for the Miracle Continent and the Platinum Zhenglan Planet. Instead of going down in person, she sent a robot to sneak in, pick up the Sheep, Wolf and Bear Man, and drop them into the Miracle Continent. After that, our ancestors thrived on the Miracle Continent and established This village. We are the product of the dark pseudo-human genetic engineering, but the interventionist gave us a way to be independent from the creator-no longer an experiment, but a free-living race. Every minute and second of our thousand-year lifespan has nothing to do with the dark pseudo-human." The four people stayed in Qianju Village for one day.
The elder received them in the meeting hall. He was an old man with a simple face and deep eyes. His thousand years of life had left traces of gentleness rather than vicissitudes of life on his face.
He took out a well-preserved crystal chip and placed it on the case - it was the recording chip of the Dark Pseudoman Laboratory, which recorded the entire process of the genetic engineering experiment that year.
The design drawings of the cultured gene cabin, the formula of the nutrient solution, and the splicing sequences of the three animal genes are all stored in the chip.
The chip is in holographic projection format. Tang Qiongkai used the holographic interface to read the data in it and transferred the technology version to
The entire truth about "making a human out of clay" is recorded in the storage area of the chip inside the body. At this moment, a silvery-white light fell from the void into Tang Qiongkai's hands - it was the message from Bai Li's Lei Yin.
Tang Qiongkai started the communication, and the holographic interface automatically opened in his vision, and two complete data packets were transmitted to the holographic computer chip in his body.
"This is part of the gyroscope information of the supernatural world, as well as the detailed files of the six protagonists of the supernatural world." Bai Lilei's lingering voice sounded in his ears,
"I didn't have time to show this part of the information when I was watching the movie World of Superpowers. Now I'll complete it for you. The six people in the magic world and the world of technology are all twelve to thirteen years old, but the six people in the world of superpowers are different in age - they are younger." Tang Qiongkai called up the information one by one, and the holographic image spread out in front of his eyes.
The first is the gyroscope information. Extreme Flame Storm, the paired engine is Sky Flame, a single-shot right-hand single-core energy-gathering engine, the attack type is the main attack type, the top type is a flat round energy-gathering tip, and the special moves are Eye of the Storm, Extreme Flame Impact, and Extreme Flame Explosion.
Blazing Feather Phoenix, the matching engine is Spirit Feather, the left-hand dual-core energy gathering engine, the attack type is defensive counterattack type, the top type is dot-shaped energy gathering tip, and the ultimate move is Fire Feather Blockade.
The aerial warrior has a blue seal matched engine, a single-shot left-hand single-core energy-gathering engine, a close-quarter agility attack type, a cross-shaped energy-gathering top type, and the special moves are aerial spin and aerial cold wind.
